Hi, That was a [product_name] "Long" model. You will need both a basic module and an expansion block: For instance: [article_no] + [article_no]. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The main concern raised in this thread is the lack of clear information regarding successor products for a discontinued [product_name] PLC ([article_no]). This gap results in user uncertainty and reliance on external advice for finding suitable replacement devices, which can cause delays and confusion in product maintenance and upgrades.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate clearly documented successor or replacement models for discontinued PLCs, with direct references between old and new compatible products to facilitate straightforward maintenance or upgrades.
